extDescription.message: Cross-browser bookmark synchronization via Nextcloud WebDAV.

setupStep1.message: In Nextcloud Files, create a folder for your bookmarks.

setupStep2.message: In Nextcloud, go to Settings › Security and create an app password.

setupStep3.message: Enter the folder's WebDAV URL, your username and the app password in the settings.

legacyWarning.message: ⚠️ A device still runs version 1.5.1 or older: it overwrites changes made elsewhere. Update the extension on all your devices.

folderUrlHint.message: Create the folder in Nextcloud Files first. Nextcloud shows the WebDAV address under Files › Files settings; add your folder name to it. Bookmarks are saved there as bookmarks_sync.json (this doesn't use the Nextcloud Bookmarks app).

passwordHint.message: Create one in Nextcloud under Settings › Security. Don't use your main password.

frequencyHint.message: Used while automatic sync is on.

importOnlyHint.message: Applies the server's changes to this browser. This browser's changes not sent yet are kept, and sent by the next sync.

errFolderNotFound.message: Folder not found. Create it in Nextcloud Files first.

errNotWebDav.message: Not a WebDAV folder URL. Use $1

errStorageFull.message: Not enough storage space on the server.

errTooManyLogins.message: Too many failed logins. Wait a moment, then check the app password.

errUnreachable.message: Server unreachable. Check the URL and your connection.

errNoAccess.message: No access to your Nextcloud server yet: click Test connection or Sync now in the popup to allow it.

errFolderCreate.message: Could not create the bookmark folder.

notSetUp.message: Not set up yet: open Settings (⚙️).

invalidRemoteFile.message: The bookmarks file on the server is invalid. Sync now to replace it.

noRemoteFile.message: No bookmarks file on the server yet: sync from a device first.

testFillIn.message: Fill in the folder URL, username and app password.

testFileUrl.message: This URL points to a file. Use the URL of a folder.

testNoCreate.message: Connected, but you can't create files in this folder (read-only share?): the extension needs to.

testFileReadOnly.message: Connected, but the bookmarks file in this folder is read-only for you.

testConnectedFile.message: Connected. Bookmarks file found on the server.

testConnectedNoFile.message: Connected. No bookmarks file yet: Sync now creates it.

localChangesPending.message: Local changes not sent yet: they will be sent with the next sync.
